name: Borneo International Marathon 2027
short_description: The Borneo International Marathon returns to Kota Kinabalu on Sunday 16 May 2027, with marathon, half marathon and 10 km races.
ai_summary: The Borneo International Marathon is scheduled for Sunday 16 May 2027 in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. It has been run since 2008 by the Kinabalu Running Club and is an AIMS member race. The event is built around the full marathon, with half marathon and 10 km races alongside it. Distances shown are those of the most recent edition; the 2027 line-up has not been published yet. The club also runs the separate Borneo Half Marathon in Kota Kinabalu each January or February.

faqs.question: When is the Borneo International Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 16 May 2027, in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah. The race is held every May, organised by the Kinabalu Running Club, which has staged it since the inaugural edition in October 2008; the 2026 edition was on Sunday 10 May.

faqs.question: What distances does the Borneo International Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: The full marathon is the headline distance, with a half marathon and a 10 km run alongside it. The distances listed here are those of the most recent edition, as the organisers have not yet published the 2027 category line-up or entry fees.
